## Clean Architecture Checklist

- [ ] Domain does not depend on Presentation or Infrastructure
- [ ] Presentation depends on Application/Domain through UseCase
- [ ] Infrastructure implements Domain/Application protocols
- [ ] DTO and Domain Entity are separated where applicable
- [ ] Dependency injection is explicit
- [ ] Test doubles can be injected
